Dispel Magic (Dispelling Touch3 Abju): R300' Successful caster level check vs. 11+caster level cancels an ongoing targeted spell, suppresses a magic item for 1d4 rd, cancels 1 spell on each creature in a 20' radius, or disrupts a foe's spell casting
Dispel Magic (Divine3 Abju): R300' Successful caster level check vs. 11+caster level cancels an ongoing targeted spell, suppresses a magic item for 1d4 rd, cancels 1 spell on each creature in a 20' radius, or disrupts a foe's spell casting
Doom (Demon Evil1 Necr): R300' Makes the target shaken (save Will negates), inflicting -2 attacks, damage, saves, and checks, for 20 min
Identify (Divine1 Divi): R60' Cone reveals info on magical auras and gives +10 Spellcraft to determine non-artifact magic item properties, for 60 rd
Imbue With Spell Ability (Divine4 Evoc): Touched with Intelligence of at least 5, Wisdom of at least 9, and 1, 3, or 5 HD gains the ability to cast chosen 1st, 2x1st, or 2x1st+2nd level spells from self prepared abjuration, divination, or healing spells (save Will negates); the Imbue With Spell Ability spell slot cannot be recovered until these spells are cast or dismissed
Miracle (Divine9 Evoc): Requests deity intercession to duplicate the effects of a cleric spell of up to 8th level, duplicate the effects of other spells of up to 7th level, undo the harmful affects of spells, or create effects of similar power; more powerful effects cost 25,000 GP to request
Planar Binding (Demon Evil6 Conj): Traps 1-3 extraplanar creatures with up to 12 HD total in a Magic Circle (save Will negates) until they perform a task (opposed Charisma allows refusal), or escape via SR, dimensional travel, or a DC 27 Charisma check
Protection From Spells (Divine8 Abju): Gives touched +8 saves vs. spells and spell-like abilities (save Will negates) for 200 min

Resurrection (Divine7 Conj): Fully restores a target willing soul, dead up to 200 years, using a piece of its corpse; the target gains a permanent negative level (level 1 targets instead suffer 2 points of Constitution drain)
Summon Monster IX (Demon Evil9 Conj): R75' Summons 1 9th-level, 1d3 8th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 20 rd
Unholy Aura (Demon Evil8 Abju): 20 creatures within 20' inflict 1d6 points of Strength damage on successful good attackers (save Fortitude negates) and gain a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class, +4 saves, SR 25 vs. good spells and casters, an additional +2 save to suppress existing mental control and possession, and immunity to new attempts to control or possess, for 20 rd
Unholy Blight (Demon Evil4 Evoc): R300' Good creatures in a 20' radius suffer 5d8 HP, or 10d6 HP if they are outsiders, and are sickened for 1d4 rd (save Will half HP only); neutral creatures suffer half HP only (save Will half)
